newsitem.title: GERMANY: Waigel sees German growth at 2.5 percent in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Waigel sees German growth at 2.5 percent in 1997.

text.p: German Finance Minister Theo Waigel said on Friday that the economy would grow by at least 2.5 percent in 1997 and would expand at a faster pace next year.
Speaking at a meeting of his Bavarian Social Union (CSU) party in Augsburg, Waigel said: "Economic growth will be at least 2.5 percent in 1997 and between 2.7 and 2.8 percent in 1998."
